manifest.title: The frozen positioning model cannot pass its own forward gate
manifest.description: Technical feasibility audit of the frozen positioning diagnostic and the attempted fresh replay source. One bounded comparison chart shows why the clipped feature term cannot cancel the intercept.

blocks.body: # The frozen positioning model cannot pass its own forward gate

## Technical summary

The prospective positioning run is rejected before scoring. The frozen model adds at least `+0.048201` log-odds to every executable market probability, so every losing condition must receive a positive probability correction. That contradicts the hard requirement that mean correction on losses be non-positive. The fresh-source attempt also found zero target PMXT events in its first two hours. **No strategy code changed, no exact profitability replay is authorized, and live trading remains off.**

## The intercept makes the loss gate impossible

The model uses an executable-market logit offset plus an intercept and two clipped standardized features. Even if both feature contributions move in the most negative admissible direction, they can subtract only `0.024935` log-odds from the `0.073136` intercept. The total correction therefore stays positive. Because the logistic function is strictly increasing, more data cannot change this structural failure.

## The public fresh replay source is not usable yet

Gamma supplied nearly complete metadata, and the checksum-verified Binance tape was contiguous. PMXT URL checks returned HTTP 200, but the filtered replay found no events for the expected candle conditions. The manifest correctly stayed incomplete. URL availability must not be treated as data coverage.

## Scope and decision definitions

The audited unit is a resolved five-minute BTC opportunity condition. The frozen diagnostic was trained on the existing 42-fold May 28–June 10 cohort and was authorized only for prospective scoring. Its forward block required at least 100 new resolved conditions, positive Brier and log-loss improvement, and a non-positive mean probability correction on losses. This audit tests whether those gates are mathematically attainable before evaluating outcomes.

## Model specification and feasibility method

For each row, the model computes `sigmoid(logit(p_market) + a + beta_1 z_1 + beta_2 z_2)`, with each standardized feature clipped to ±5. The worst-case feature term is bounded by `5 × (|beta_1| + |beta_2|)`. Subtracting that bound from the intercept proves the sign of every admissible correction. The fresh attempt used one frozen zero-trade capture variant, continuous state, 202 ms latency, and session-owned atomic parquet cleanup.

## The retained strategy remains profitable but A−

The retained volatility-floor strategy still has `102` trades and `+$13.54` after fees, but it misses Wilson confidence, profitable-report breadth, loss-cluster, and second-half stability requirements. Rejecting the positioning diagnostic does not reduce those gaps and does not justify changing any live control.

## Limitations and robustness checks

This is a feasibility rejection, not an out-of-sample score. It establishes that the frozen model cannot pass one hard gate and that the tested public replay hours lack target events. It does not show that every possible exogenous feature is useless. The PMXT run was intentionally stopped after two hours because continuing could not reverse either failure. The 72-hour storage estimate is a linear capacity bound from the observed July 14 recorder rate, not a guarantee of future byte volume.

## Recommended next step

1. Close the positioning family; do not refit its intercept or tune a neighboring transform on the same folds.
2. Preserve `primary_v6_volfloor_300`, the unchanged A+ gates, and `LIVE_TRADING_OFF`.
3. With explicit authorization, deploy a measurement-capable collector to the PolyMomentum tenant only.
4. Capture fresh CLOB, Binance RTDS, and Chainlink RTDS in bounded segments; convert and verify each owned segment before deleting only its raw files.
5. Pre-register one genuinely new causal mechanism before inspecting its outcomes, then require at least 100 resolved opportunity conditions and a second disjoint block.

## Further questions

- Should the next capture deployment be authorized on the VPS now?
- Can the collector be rotated and converted without creating decision-time gaps around market boundaries?
- Which new mechanism will be fixed before the fresh outcomes are inspected?
